title: Croquetas de Jamón
description: A traditional Spain dish made with all-purpose flour, whole cow milk, serrano ham, chicken egg. This home-style preparation follows its characteristic cooking method and uses measured ingredients.

steps.instruction: Make a very thick béchamel by cooking butter and flour briefly and whisking in milk little by little. Continue stirring until it releases cleanly from the pan.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Spread the ham béchamel in a shallow dish, cover its surface and chill thoroughly until firm enough to shape into croquettes.
Pat dry, then coat evenly with the listed breading or flour components; press lightly to help it adhere.
Fry shaped portions in small batches in oil heated to about 170–175°C for about 12 minutes, until golden; drain on a rack.
